# function: route53_recovery_cluster_routingcontrol

Builds the ARN of an `route53-recovery-cluster` `routingcontrol`:

```
arn:${Partition}:route53-recovery-control::${Account}:controlpanel/${ControlPanelId}/routingcontrol/${RoutingControlId}
```

`${Partition}`, `${Region}` and `${Account}` come from the configuration file (`.arn.hcl`, or the path in `ARN_CONFIG`). The remaining placeholders are the arguments, in template order.



## Signature

<!-- signature generated by tfplugindocs -->
```text
route53_recovery_cluster_routingcontrol(control_panel_id string, routing_control_id string, options map of string...) string
```

## Arguments

<!-- arguments generated by tfplugindocs -->
1. `control_panel_id` (String) Value for `${ControlPanelId}` in the ARN template.
1. `routing_control_id` (String) Value for `${RoutingControlId}` in the ARN template.
<!-- variadic argument generated by tfplugindocs -->
1. `options` (Variadic, Map of String) Optional overrides: `account` (the name of an `account` block in the configuration file), `account_id` (a literal account id), `region` and `partition`. At most one options map may be given.
